SOLICITATION W9124D-26-R-0019, CUSTODIAL SERVICES, FORT CALDER, KENTUCKY

THE PURPOSE OF THIS AMENDMENT IS TO (1) REVISE SECTION J, ATTACHMENT J-0001, TECHNICAL EXHIBIT 1 (TE-1), CUSTODIAL FACILITY LIST, TO CORRECT THE GROSS SQUARE FOOTAGE OF THREE (3) FACILITIES, ADD TWO (2) FACILITIES AND DELETE ONE (1) FACILITY; (2) INCORPORATE QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS NO. 1; AND (3) EXTEND THE DATE FOR RECEIPT OF PROPOSALS FROM 30 JUNE 2026 TO 10 JULY 2026, 2:00 PM EASTERN TIME.

SEE SF 30 BLOCK 14 CONTINUATION PAGES 2 THROUGH 3.

Except as provided herein, all terms and conditions of the document referenced in Item 9A or 10A, as heretofore changed, remains unchanged and in full force and effect.

SUMMARY OF CHANGES

1. PURPOSE

The purpose of this amendment is to:

a. Revise Section J, Attachment J-0001, Technical Exhibit 1 (TE-1), Custodial Facility List, to correct the gross square footage (GSF) of three (3) facilities, add two (2) facilities, and delete one (1) facility, as set forth in paragraph 3 below;

b. Incorporate the Government’s responses to questions received from industry (Questions and Answers No. 1, issued with this amendment); and

c. Extend the date and time for receipt of proposals.

2. SECTION J, ATTACHMENT J-0001, PWS PARAGRAPH 1.3

Paragraph 1.3, Scope and Estimated Workload, is changed as follows:

FROM: “The custodial workload consists of twenty-six (26) facilities totaling 593,210 gross square feet (GSF) in three service zones, as listed in TE-1.”

TO: “The custodial workload consists of twenty-seven (27) facilities totaling 627,675 gross square feet (GSF) in three service zones, as listed in TE-1, as amended.”

3. SECTION J, ATTACHMENT J-0001, TECHNICAL EXHIBIT 1 (TE-1), CUSTODIAL FACILITY LIST

3.1 Gross square footage corrections. The GSF of the following TE-1 line items is changed as shown. All other data for these line items (number of floors, service frequency, service hours and remarks) is unchanged.

TE-1 ItemBldg No.Facility Name / DescriptionGross Square Feet (GSF)Change (+/−)Basis for Change
WasIs Changed To
2104Directorate of Public Works (DPW) Administration Building18,24019,860+1,620Field-verified; the 2024 second-floor addition over the east wing was not yet in the real property record.
141210Mission Training Complex (Classrooms and Battle Simulation)31,64033,120+1,480Corrected to include the after-action review wing.
172101Physical Fitness Center (Ruiz Fitness Center)54,78052,980−1,800Racquetball court wing demolished October 2025; real property record corrected. See Questions and Answers No. 1, Question 4.

3.2 Deletion. TE-1 Item 7, Building 118, Education Center Annex (Testing Center), 7,920 GSF, Weekly: Building 118 is deleted from the requirement in its entirety. The testing function relocates to Building 124 in July 2026, and Building 118 is programmed for demolition under the FY2026 facility reduction program. Item 7 is reserved; the remaining TE-1 line items are not renumbered.

4. SECTION L – DATE FOR RECEIPT OF PROPOSALS

Paragraph L.2, Proposal Submission, is changed as follows:

FROM: “Proposals are due no later than 30 June 2026, 2:00 PM Eastern Time.”

TO: “Proposals are due no later than 10 July 2026, 2:00 PM Eastern Time.”

5. QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS

Questions and Answers No. 1 (thirteen questions), issued with this amendment, is hereby incorporated into the solicitation. No further questions will be accepted.

6. ACKNOWLEDGMENT

Offerors shall acknowledge receipt of this amendment in accordance with Block 11 of the SF 30. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.
